summary: The agent implements a CatBoost regression model with 5-fold cross-validation, datetime feature extraction, and target encoding. However, it applies a random split instead of a time-based split, which introduces look-ahead bias for chronological data. Furthermore, it leaks test set distribution information into the training set by computing frequency encodings on the concatenated dataset before splitting.
